overview_description.description: Semble is an online lending platform that facilitates low cost financing for nonprofit organizations. This is done by using Semble’s ("Social Investment") model that allows socially responsible investors to invest in the loan needs of nonprofits that they support. As enough funds to address the need are invested by supporters, the nonprofit receives these funds as a loan. Loan payments are then directed back to those that invested.

product.name: Semble Online Lending Platform
product.description: An online platform that facilitates below-market-rate loans for U.S. nonprofits by connecting them with impact investors and banks to meet their loan needs.

product.name: Loan Calculator
product.description: A tool for nonprofits to evaluate and compare financing options by adjusting key loan variables to estimate potential savings and impact.

product.name: Loan Coordination and Advisory Service
product.description: A service that analyzes nonprofit loan needs, evaluates financing options, negotiates with banks, and structures investment opportunities with supporters to secure cost-effective loans.
